name: How long does professional bathroom tile installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional bathroom tile installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiling an average bathroom usually takes three to five days from surface preparation to final cleanup. The timeline starts with inspecting and repairing the subfloor or wall substrate, followed by applying a continuous waterproof membrane in shower zones. Setting the tile takes one to two days depending on the pattern complexity, room size, and tile dimensions. Thin-set mortar requires a full 24-hour cure before applying grout. After grouting, sealants and silicone caulk need another 24 hours to set before the shower can safely be exposed to running water. Large bathrooms or intricate mosaic designs can extend this schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional bathroom tile installation typically takes three to five days, including surface prep, waterproofing, setting tile, grouting, and curing.
